digest.component_or_area: ticket close transition and state reduction
propositions: A reader cannot distinguish a close whose completion-signature append failed from one closed with the gate off, because close provenance is discarded after use and only reported ephemerally in the payload.
The gate state (ENABLED, DISABLED, UNREADABLE) must be persisted durably on the *->closed STATUS event in the same locked write as the close, avoiding additional lock acquisition and audit sidecars.

A completion_expectation enum with 8 values (required, disposition, gate_off, gate_unreadable, force_bypassed, local_source, not_certifiable, not_applicable) must be computed and recorded on the close STATUS event to encode why a completion signature was or was not expected.

The expectation must be computed as the second half of _completion_precheck's returned pair, with gate state resolution preceding force_bypassed detection, and with not_applicable set explicitly on the idea->closed transition path.

The field must be folded into reduced state by _fold_close_metadata on both *->closed edges, declared as a present-only enum in schema, and remain backward-compatible with legacy close events lacking the key.

A later reader combining durable expectation with durable attestation can discriminate: required+attestation (signed), required+none (lost), disposition±attestation (disposition-signed or lost), and other values indicating non-applicability with precise reason.
